Gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2023 were USD 2.151m (net USD 1.290m). No prior-year reserve movement is reported (no prior underwriting years), and the syndicate notes that it relied on LMA benchmark data for reserves and IBNR, increasing estimation uncertainty.
raw_causal_phrases: Due to 2023 being the Syndicates first underwriting year of account it has primarily used LMA benchmark data to generate its significant estimates around claims reserves and development patterns. This increases the uncertainty in the estimates held.
The IBNR provision also includes an explicit margin, a liability for a reasonable and prudent level of conservatism to cover adverse claim deviation.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.
